The query returned **7,180 blocks** for mainnet on 20 June 2026. Each row shows the slot, slot start time, block root, the minimum `seen_slot_start_diff` (first-seen delay in ms), and the actual first-seen timestamp. For example:

| Slot | Slot Start (UTC) | First Seen (ms after slot start) | First Seen At |
|------|---|---|---|

| 14590960 | 2026-06-20 00:12:23 | 215 ms | 2026-06-20 00:12:23.215 |
| 14590978 | 2026-06-20 00:12:59 | 3,504 ms | 2026-06-20 00:13:02.504 |
| 14597798 | 2026-06-20 23:19:59 | 3,192 ms | 2026-06-20 23:20:02.192 |
